name: Bloodletter
author: vkays
description: Adds a unique scimitar, displayed as 'Scimitar of Bloodletting', found in Lucia's chest during the Test Pocket quest. On a successful hit, has a 30% chance to inflict a bleeding wound (2-4 Slashing damage every 5 seconds for 15 seconds). Ships genuinely new icon art built from a render (new_artwork/sword_render_03.png) rather than a recolor of an existing icon -- the first in this project, made possible by solving the mdl16 per-row offset table (see docs/mdl16-icon-format.md).
